description: This Java source file defines the 'ClearCacheLine' class which extends 'EntityOperation'. It implements functionality for the <clear-cache-line> element in the MiniLang language, allowing cache lines to be cleared in the context of entity operations within the OFBiz framework. The class includes constructor validation, an execution method that interacts with the Delegator to clear cache lines, and a factory class for creating instances of 'ClearCacheLine'.
